scope: Scoped canonical anonymous-pipe carrier and staged request-bound native controller operand. No credential acquisition, supported dispatcher routing, complete ordinary network program, complete funding/admission, live qualification, runtime-epoch retirement or phase/class closure.
behavior_contract: Only the existing published OrdinaryCascadeController family can receive the owned descriptor. Null input remains the default.
The owner binds the original key and work window, offers once, attempts delivery only after an actual manager reply and closes the writer on success, error or cancellation.
Raw frames are at most 65536 bytes and never enter request/config files, logs or digests. The receiver requires an anonymous pipe under the actual original process owner.
The staged credential frame binds version, original key and public request digest. Foreign, malformed, trailing, noncanonical, expired or missing input refuses.
The fixed controller reads synthetic credentials under its actual parent and validates backend region before caller preparation. Real prompt-origin integration remains open.
